title: Formalize the main-first, pinned-upstream fork patch workflow. Preserve pure upstream baselines and validated fork snapshots, develop ordinary features on stable main, reconcile newer upstream separately with late main-feature coverage, and support optional approved backports. Separate main/source proof from package/release qualification. Retain the existing narrow historical verifier exception only with exact replay proof; never waive malformed attestations or unexplained product changes. Extend existing fork maintenance policy and add an operations guide without changing runtime behavior.
